name: plc-training
description: PLC tabletop training site + offline OOXML export

scripts.generate-offline: node scripts/export_training_data.js && python3 scripts/generate_offline_ooxml.py && python3 scripts/generate_offline_pdf.py
scripts.generate-offline:pptx: python3 -m pip install -r scripts/requirements-offline.txt && node scripts/export_training_data.js && python3 scripts/generate_offline_ooxml.py && python3 scripts/generate_offline_pdf.py
scripts.generate-offline:deps: python3 -m pip install -r scripts/requirements-offline.txt && npm run generate-offline
